scope: Current development execution, continuation, scoring, provenance and checkpoints; no paid calls or frozen study edits

findings.title: Unusable provider responses were incorrectly reusable checkpoints
findings.evidence: New real-loop mocked-provider regression failed for incomplete, refused and empty output before the fix. Resume made zero calls instead of retrying the stopped API. The helper now rejects all provider-* categories as well as llm-error.
findings.validation: Repeated provider failure stops each explicit invocation at round 0; previous successes are reused; earlier attempt bytes stay unchanged.

findings.title: Single-condition CLI silently scheduled both paid arms
findings.evidence: --run --condition original scheduled original and generated_d1 in an offline subprocess spy before correction. It now schedules only original.
findings.validation: Parametrized tests cover Original only, D1 only, and both when no condition filter is supplied.

findings.title: Summary costs omitted previous failed provider attempts after resume
findings.evidence: Real native loop with mocked returned usage generated 3 responses totaling 15 input and 6 output tokens. Final per-target metrics retained only 2 responses, 10 input and 4 output tokens.
findings.validation: A new condition-local receipt ledger recovers all 3/15/6, retains unknown usage on interrupted/missing responses, and does not sum historical/replay directories. Separate final_target_metric_totals retains diagnostic metrics without pretending they are total spend.

findings.title: Historical-success reuse omits the transport contract comparison
findings.evidence: Changing transport_contract.adapter_sha256 yielded reuse_blockers=[] with runtime_verified=True.
findings.impact: Current force_fresh cohort has no historical pass reuse. Future reuse could mix provider adapter or retry-policy versions.
findings.fix: Added transport_contract to the strict component comparison. Identical contracts retain reuse eligibility; changed and missing contracts reject it.
